messages.text:
"Make a 3D first person game where you start with a camera and your job is to find a T Rex and take a picture of it. But there is challenges that you'll have to go through on the way. You start in the hyperrealistic forest with a bunch of rivers around you. You can take pictures of animals in different dinosaurs and sell the pictures for certain amount of money depends on which animal or dinosaur it is. There was a shop nearby your camp where you spawn at where you can buy items
 Or vehicles that can make you move through The area quicker, then ever to help find the trex.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
